summary: SoundMap MVP tested end-to-end. 17/17 backend pytest cases pass (REST + WebSocket). Frontend login page renders correctly, Spotify OAuth redirect works (redirect URI is registered - reached Spotify's 'Welcome back' login form, not an error page), and unauthenticated /map properly redirects to login. No blocking issues found.

issues: Deprecation warnings in console: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow); props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking but should be cleaned up.

action_items: Optional: upgrade @react-native-async-storage/async-storage to 2.2.0 and expo-location to ~19.0.8 per Expo compat warning.
Optional: replace deprecated shadow* props with boxShadow and move pointerEvents into style.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py WebSocket route is mounted with raw prefix '/api/ws' directly on `app` (not via api_router) - works because Kubernetes ingress routes /api/* to backend, which is correct.
StateStore is in-memory only - acceptable for MVP but will lose all sessions/users on backend restart; fine as documented MVP scope.

spotify_callback redirects back with access_token+refresh_token in URL query string - tokens are exposed in browser history/referer headers. Consider POST-redirect or short-lived one-time code exchange for production hardening (not MVP blocker).

spotify/play endpoint catches spotipy.SpotifyException and returns its http_status - good; other endpoints (pause/next/previous/seek/queue) only return 400 regardless of actual Spotify error - minor inconsistency.
seed_data_creation: None needed - WebSocket tests use ephemeral TEST_ prefixed user_ids that auto-cleanup on disconnect.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_soundmap.py cover all REST + WebSocket flows. WebSocket test helper _recv_until() filters messages by type since connection generates multiple broadcast messages. Spotify OAuth redirect URI https://beat-together-2.preview.emergentagent.com/api/spotify/callback IS registered in the Spotify Dashboard (confirmed - login flow reaches Spotify's real login form). End-to-end OAuth completion requires a real Spotify account and cannot be automated.
